# Allowlist for the sanitization scan
#
# Lines matching any of these patterns are NOT treated as findings —
# even if they contain a pattern from a denylist.
#
# Format: one extended regex (ERE) per line, applied to the full match line
# (including file path and line number).
#
# Keep this list lean. Every entry here is a hole in the protection and
# needs a justification in the comment above it.

# The repo's own clone URL. It necessarily contains the GitHub account name
# and must appear in the repo, otherwise the one-liner on a fresh machine
# won't work (prepare.sh, README, docs/09-UMZUG.md).
github\.com[:/]leonkoellerwirth-arch/kickoff-ai
raw\.githubusercontent\.com/leonkoellerwirth-arch/kickoff-ai

# Placeholder addresses in examples and templates.
# example.com/.org/.net are reserved for documentation per RFC 2606 and
# can never be a real address — allowed unconditionally.
@example\.(com|org|net)
(your|you|deine|dein|du|user|name|beispiel|example)@
noreply@|users\.noreply\.github\.com

# The deny- and allowlists themselves naturally contain patterns.
sanitize-(denylist|allowlist)
docs/(de/)?05-SANITI(SIERUNG|ZATION)\.md
